career_ladder.note: Lower Division Clerks (LDC) / Clerks form the foundational ministerial executive cadre across departments of the Government of Kerala. Recruits enter at Pay Scale ₹26,500 - ₹60,700 and advance through Senior Clerk, Head Clerk, Junior Superintendent, and Senior Superintendent up to administrative gazetted posts upon passing the requisite Departmental Tests and Secretariat/Manual tests conducted by Kerala PSC.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Lower Division Clerk / Clerk across all 14 revenue districts is conducted through a two-stage examination process: Common Tenth Level Preliminary Examination (Objective OMR screening test carrying 100 marks) followed by the District-wise Main Written Examination (Objective OMR carrying 100 marks). Final district-wise ranked lists are prepared strictly on the basis of marks secured in the Main Written Examination.

financial_package.note: Lower Division Clerks in Kerala State Government service are remunerated under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) at Pay Scale ₹26,500 - ₹60,700 with entry basic pay of ₹26,500.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification Cat. No. 503/2023 & Kerala Government 11th Pay Revision Order
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹26,500 with project standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹15,370) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A Corporation ₹2,650, Class B Municipalities ₹1,800, Class C Panchayats ₹1,200) and medical allowance (₹500/month); net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹4,187), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government housing quarters allotment or House Rent Allowance based on district station
Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹3 lakh per annum under the Kerala Government MEDISEP scheme
Earned leave, casual leave, and maternity/paternity leave benefits under Kerala Service Rules (KSR)
Festival allowance / Onam bonus and special festival advance
Subsidized departmental loans and welfare fund assistance
